title: Modular tests build plan

short.lead: The build is seven steps, one issue each, starting with the rule text; I need your approval to begin step 1.
short.hint: Tap a step to see it.
items: Write the rule and its detail file
Adds the "Tests are modules" section to the rules file, a detail file, and the `checks.json` entry.

items.alt: The gate: a test with a module is saved, one without is refused.
items.caption: The gate: a test with a module is saved, one without is refused.

items: Add the `refactor on` and `refactor off` switch
A typed line saved like the other switches and listed in the mode command.
A check that refuses a test file with no module header, naming the line to add.

items.alt: The gate: a test with a module is saved, one without is refused.
items.caption: The gate: a test with a module is saved, one without is refused.

items: Build the skill, command and audit
`/house-rules:modular-tests audit` and `convert <path>`, and the list in `docs/3-state/non-modular-tests.md`.

items.alt: The audit writes the list of tests that are not modular yet.
items.caption: The audit writes the list of tests that are not modular yet.

items: The first real conversion, with the same number of checks before and after.

items.alt: One big script becomes modules that run alone or chained.
items.caption: One big script becomes modules that run alone or chained.

items: File two conversion issues for the offshoot suites
One issue each for the agent-router and prompt-workshop suites.
Updates the docs tiers, adds the changelog line, and bumps the plugin version.
Tap Copy my reply and send it.

changes: Done when: `verify.py` passes with the new rule section mapped to its check.
Done when: a `verify.py` case types `refactor on` and reads it back as on.
Done when: `verify.py` cases show a new modular file allowed, a new file with no header refused, an end-to-end file allowed, and an old non-modular file refused only during a refactor.
Done when: the audit writes `docs/3-state/non-modular-tests.md` naming `tools/verify_tools.py` and both offshoot suites as not modular.
Done when: the full run reports the same check count as before the split and `--parts install` runs only the install checks.
Done when: two open issues exist, one per suite.
Done when: `verify.py`, `verify_tools.py`, `docref.py check` and `docs_drift.py` all exit 0 and the version-bump check passes.

wrapup.summary: This plan builds the modular-tests rule in seven steps, each tracked as its own issue under #575 (Modular tests: every test is a module that runs alone or chained).
wrapup.changing: The rules file and a detail file, one hook check, a typed switch, a new skill and command, a state-tier list of non-modular tests, tools/verify_tools.py split into modules, and the docs and version.
wrapup.blocking: Your approval of this plan. Plunderspell's repository name is still needed from you, as owner/repo, if you want its tests converted.
wrapup.next: After you approve, I build step 1.
